title: Juicy Crumbly Mediterranean Egg Frittata
description: A spicy and crumbly one-pot Mediterranean dish featuring free-range eggs, perfect for a satisfying meal. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs and smoked paprika.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat and add the diced red bell pepper and red onion.
Cook the vegetables until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the crumbled feta cheese, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables and cheese in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
